strengths: Comprehensive experimental validation across 4 major benchmarks with rigorous causal verification (Figures 5-6 show latent states encode genuine computation, not padding)
Substantial practical impact: 10.84× average inference speedup alongside improved performance on open-ended tasks; competitive with much larger models on some metrics
Novel empirical discovery: Spontaneous CoT internalization phenomenon well-documented; hydraulic trade-off (Figure 6) showing flexible arbitration between implicit/explicit reasoning is compelling
Technical soundness: ChemUpdater mechanism for dynamic molecular representation refinement is well-motivated; four-stage training protocol is justified with component ablations (Table 4)
Strong presentation: Clear motivation (Figure 1), logical flow, effective visualizations, and extensive reproducibility materials including dataset snapshot dates and full implementation details
Well-designed causal ablations: Gaussian noise replacement of latent tokens monotonically degrades performance, rigorously establishing functional necessity of latent computation
weaknesses: Incomplete mechanistic explanation of the central finding: Paper demonstrates spontaneous internalization occurs but not why. The 'optimization over imitation' explanation is superficial—why would correctness/validity rewards lead to abandoning explicit reasoning? Critical unanswered question: would any reward-optimized model learn compression regardless of the latent interface?

Tenuous connection between theory and practice: Appendix A's manifold formalization assumes perfect manifold learning and non-degenerate representation speed (unlikely to hold). Theorem A.9 lacks empirical validation of curvature assumptions, and the jump from theoretical bounds to 10.84× speedup remains unjustified

Limited generalizability to deterministic tasks: Closed-ended tasks show marginal improvements (49.88% vs 44.10% on Mol-Instructions Closed, Table 2) or degradation, suggesting the approach is task-specific rather than a fundamental improvement. Paper acknowledges but doesn't analyze when/why latent reasoning fails

Baseline comparison concerns: Explicit CoT baseline (Stage 1+2+4) uses identical GRPO training as LatentChem, conflating architectural advantages with training regimen differences. Unclear whether improvements are from continuous representation or superior optimization

Insufficient interpretability of latent reasoning: RSA analysis (Figure 7b) only measures structural correlation preservation without explaining what chemistry the latent vectors actually encode. t-SNE visualizations are potentially misleading. No mechanistic analysis of learned representations

Incremental methodological novelty: Latent reasoning (Coconut, Deng et al. 2024) and dynamic attention refinement are established; ChemUpdater is a straightforward application of cross-attention requerying
Underexplored design space: Latent budget (T_max) sensitivity not studied, different GRPO reward formulations not tested, stage 3 freezing strategy justified only conceptually without ablation
Task-dependent efficiency variations unexplained: Speedups range from 5.4× to 29.9× (Figure 8) with no analysis of why. Pattern (reaction > optimization > description) is interesting but not analyzed

Limited evaluation scope: Only 14k training samples with unknown scaling behavior; no out-of-distribution evaluation; no human evaluation beyond property metrics; only Qwen-3-8B backbone tested; no analysis of failure modes

strengths: Comprehensive experimental evaluation across 4 diverse benchmarks with proper statistical testing (sign test, non-tie win rates, seed robustness); strong empirical results (59.88% win rate on ChemCoTBench, 10.84× average efficiency gain)
Novel discovery of spontaneous internalization—models autonomously suppress explicit CoT when optimized for outcomes, providing interesting emergent behavior with practical implications
Well-designed technical approach combining ChemUpdater for dynamic molecular perception with progressive four-stage training protocol; all components validated through ablations

Rigorous causal analysis demonstrating latent states perform actual computation (Figure 5), flexible trade-off between implicit/explicit reasoning (Figure 6), and preserved structural fidelity via RSA (Figure 7)
Excellent reproducibility: dataset snapshot dates, complete hyperparameters, detailed appendices with implementation details, and thorough discussion of limitations and failure modes
Strong performance on open-ended generative chemistry tasks with intuitive motivation for the modality mismatch hypothesis that will resonate with the ICML community
weaknesses: Central 'modality mismatch' hypothesis is intuitive but not rigorously validated—empirical gains could come from architectural flexibility or computational efficiency rather than latent space being the 'native substrate' for chemical reasoning; confounding factor that LatentChem has additional learnable parameters (ChemUpdater, latent projector) versus CoT baseline

Spontaneous internalization may be optimization artifact: models learn that suppressing CoT reduces generation cost without accuracy loss, which doesn't necessarily prove latent space is fundamentally more suited for chemical logic; alternative explanation not adequately addressed

Theoretical contribution (Curvature-Resolution Theorem) is explicitly informal and speculative; connection between representation-space curvature and empirical efficiency gains remains unvalidated; feels disconnected from main narrative

Highly task-dependent gains (29.9× for reactions, 5.4× for descriptions) undermine claim of universal superiority; weak or marginal performance on closed-ended tasks (50% win rate vs. 63.73% on open-ended) contradicts generality of approach

Interpretability trade-off not adequately addressed—critical for scientific applications requiring auditability; proposed hybrid System 1/System 2 solution is deferred to future work; safety concerns mentioned but unresolved

Limited scope (chemistry only) with unclear generalization to other domains; main results on 8B model with limited exploration of scaling behavior; insufficient comparison with recent latent reasoning baselines beyond Coconut
